## About Me 👋

Welcome to my portfolio! I am **Partha Sai Guttikonda**, a passionate machine learning enthusiast and software engineer with a strong foundation in developing innovative solutions at the intersection of technology and healthcare. 🎓 I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Texas at Arlington, where my research focused on **multimodal algorithms, Vision Language Models (VLMs), and 3D modalities** for medical applications. 💻

Over the course of my academic and professional journey, I have contributed to impactful research projects, including:

- 🧪 Developing a 3D visualization platform for multiplexed immunofluorescence imaging.
- ⚔️ Conducting adversarial attacks on Vision Language Models for pathology.
- 🩺 Building a digital pathology viewer integrated with deep learning-based search engines.

These experiences have fueled my passion for creating AI-driven solutions that address real-world challenges in healthcare. 🚀

Currently, I work as a Software Engineer at Southwest Airlines ✈️, where I design and implement efficient, scalable systems leveraging cloud technologies such as AWS Lambda. Previously, I gained hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer at **Vantashala**, a startup now in production in Texas, where I worked on both frontend (Vue.js) and backend (Java Spring Boot) development. 🔧

This portfolio showcases my journey, projects, and research contributions. 🌟 I am eager to explore opportunities where I can apply my expertise in machine learning and software engineering to create meaningful impact. 🌍

Outside of my professional work, I’m an avid photographer. I love freezing memories and stories through my camera. 📸 Take a look at 👉 [my Unsplash portfolio here](https://unsplash.com/@guttikondaparthasai)!

Feel free to explore my work and get in touch to discuss potential collaborations! 📩
